programme.title: Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade

programme.title: Raiders of the Lost Ark
programme.desc: Get ready for thrills in Indiana Jones and the Raiders of the Lost Ark. Indy and his ex-flame Marion Ravenwood dodge booby-traps, fight Nazis, and stare down snakes in their incredible worldwide quest for the mystical Ark of the Covenant.

programme.title: Empire of the Sun
programme.desc: This epic drama chronicles J.G. Ballard's remarkable struggle to survive a childhood marked by betrayal, death, and disappointment, while trapped in Shanghai during the Japanese occupation of World War II.

programme.title: 30 Days of Night: Dark Days

programme.title: Texas Chainsaw Massacre 3D

programme.title: The Last Exorcism Part II

programme.title: Little Shop of Horrors

programme.title: The Monster Squad

programme.desc: The con is on when scam artists and lovers Irving Rosenfeld and Sydney Prosser are entrapped by ambitious FBI agent Richie DiMaso and coerced into participating in a sting operation that hinges on snaring politician Carmine Polito and his associates.

programme.title: Reservoir Dogs
programme.desc: After a seemingly perfectly planned robbery goes awry, a group of criminals begins to suspect a traitor in their ranks, and back at their headquarters, they try to suss out the culprit.

programme.title: Bad Lieutenant
